components.title: Storage adds three safety gates:
components.text: safety study · completion safety check · review after start (No. 65)

footnote: Source: NEA Document No. 7 (2025), Articles 12 to 35, NEA Document No. 65 (2025). Timing for each step is set after the survey
notes: Six steps, in the order NEA Document No. 7 sets. First the survey: roof structure, switch room and connection point, with a structural opinion. Second, the design and the numbers, worked from your bills and contract. Third, the step that matters most: apply to the grid, and start no work until its connection opinion is in hand, while the investor files the project on its AC capacity, which is you if self-funded and the investor under an EMC. Fourth, construction by a qualified contractor to the structural, fire, waterproofing, wind and lightning requirements. Fifth, grid acceptance: the grid reviews the equipment test reports and the system runs once it passes inspection. Sixth, operation, reconciled monthly. Each step ends with a document for you to sign off. If storage is included, Document No. 65 adds three safety gates. Once running, Document No. 7 allows the export mode to be changed once.
